UI:

GAMEPLAY/BALANCE:

 Cotton now requires slightly more per level but gives more XP per level for simple missions.
 Night market items no longer cycle during the day, but cooldowns still elapse.

 Slide-lock now costs at minimum 5 and maximum 100 (was 0-120).
 Stones are worth slightly more XP in missions, and scale slightly less aggressively.
 Puzzle boxes are now sellable.
 Decreased value of magma fountain: 1250 -> 1150.
 Made it marginally less likely to get offered to buy radiant planks from blubs.
 Mossy boulders and sandy boulders will now drop fibre and raw iron respectively most of the time.
 Normal boulders will now rarely drop a boulder buddy.
 Slightly decreased raw iron and iron bar quantity requirement and increase XP reward per unit for simple missions.
 Made complex missions net more XP typically.
 Decreased value of gravel: 15 -> 10.
 Increased spawn frequency of iron nodes on gravel, red sand and red dirt.
 Rich iron nodes replace regular iron nodes when spawning on red dirt/sand.
 Simple missions scale less aggressively in regards to quantity asked for each level (1%/level -> .67%/level)
 Added simple missions support for the remainder of eligible resources.
 Balanced many of the values for simple missions.
 Added Mechanic Mayhem event.
 Added level 60 emporium review.
 At least 60% is needed now to receive rewards from the level 20 review.


BUGS/TECHNICAL:

 Free wheel spins from task rewards now count towards total spins and rarity drop tallies.
 Corrected lemon and cherry trees not having unlock alerts when setting enabled.
 Fixed level 5 review not generating correctly.
 Fixed solar panels still slowly working when facing south west and it's not light enough.
 Fixed left borders not showing on walls if the left wall extended past the length of the right wall.
 Fixed coconut mastery and pebble pet mastery not alerting the player correctly when completed.
 Keyboard cursor no longer conflicts with new menu page navigation shortcuts.


MISC:

 Top leader-boards now show the top 30 players.
 Added hyphen in "Slide Lock" Blub offer to make it consistent with other mentions of it.
 Added "Director Pinecone", "General Azimuth" and "Secret Agent Klunk" has rare agent names.
 Locked puzzle box unlocks no longer state which number unlocks it.

notes.title: Blub Emporium Update Notes - Version Beta 1Q
notes.notes:
Blub Emporium Beta 1Q - 
Compression and tech! This update takes much of the content in the game that many people have never seen or even known existed, and shifts them all together in order to make the game flow a lot better. In this update are many large scale balance changes, like major wheel odds improvements, price reductions on expansions, and significantly reducing the level cap and as a result how frequently expansions and items are unlocked. Also, enhanced farm gen, automated Harvesters, and Farm hole-punching!

ITEMS AND RESOURCES:

 Added "Demolish Bomb" (Farm Special).
 Added "Lunar Harvester" (Farm Special).
 Added "Paint Palette" (Emporium Deco).
 Added "Terrain Obfuscator" (Farm Special).


VISUAL:

 Changed the tab icon for new item alerts to have a slight outline to help with visibility in certain ui themes.
 Retextured mystic shards.
 Retextured moonstones.
 Changed the main menu background again (Random variants likely coming).


UI:

 Changed items obtained from levelling up to now show before unlocks.
 Item alerts now not only show the category in icon form, but also allow the hovering of it to see it in written form.

notes.title: Blub Emporium Update Notes - Version Beta 1N
notes.notes:
Blub Emporium Beta 1N - 
This update brings not much on the content front but a large change to how everything is interacted with. Items are no longer interacted with by tapping the interact button, but rather by holding it for varying durations of time. Most items feature a "Boost Zone" in which if the interact button is released at the correct time, a small buff will be applied; conversely if it is released in a "Hindrance Zone" then adverse effects will be applied to whatever is being interacted with. This update also contains a super satisfying "Resource Icon Flux" effect that shows newly gotten resources at the site of acquisition in a circular formation, this can be disabled in the settings menu if for some reason it isn't your cup of tea.

ITEMS AND RESOURCES:

 Added "Bluecalyptus Boards" (Emporium Tile).
 Added "Cosmic Barrier" (Divider).
 Added "Pointed Potted Tree" (Emporium Deco).
 Added all pale colour variations of Clad Tables (Tables).


VISUAL:

 Decreased the intensity of conveyor belts' occlusion.

 Decreased the intensity of the basic round table's occlusion.


UI:

 Changed all interactions to require the interact button be held for varying durations depending on the item.
 Demolish button now needs to be held for as long as they demolish outside of edit-mode, otherwise a default duration of 1.5 seconds.
